email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'd like to apply for the Marketing & Communication Internship at CBRE. I work daily where content, SEO and web meet: writing and publishing SEO content, managing WordPress sites for clients, preparing material for social and email channels, and reporting on performance in Google Analytics and Search Console.

Organisation is a big part of that work. I keep roughly 600 member profile pages consistent on a pharmacists' association site, run iterative audits, and coordinate content with a remote team. An internship where I support events, internal communication and incoming requests while learning from your Marketing & Communication Manager is exactly the next step I want to take.

My English is fluent, my Dutch is at B1 writing level and I'm actively improving my speaking. I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I can contribute.

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

CBRE's internship description reads like a list of things I already do daily, with a few I want to get better at. I'd like to bring my digital marketing background to your team.

For the past year I've worked as a freelancer and as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, handling on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, and managing pages, blog posts and media in WordPress. On majistraleczacilari.org.tr I maintain a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profile pages - the kind of detail work that keeps a large site and its communication coherent. Reporting is part of my routine: Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs tell me what a campaign did and what to change next. I'm GA4 and Google Ads Search certified, and I work in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, so I understand what sits behind the content I publish.

Writing is where I'm strongest. I write SEO content, website copy and social posts in English, and I have a technical grasp of how that content performs in traditional and AI-driven search. Press releases and internal communication are areas I'd be glad to develop under your Marketing & Communication Manager. My English is fluent, my Dutch is at B1 writing level and I'm working on my speaking. I pick up tools quickly - I taught myself WordPress, Elementor, Shopify and the analytics stacks I use now.

I'm organised, I like working alongside people, and I'd rather ask for feedback than guess. I'd be happy to show you what I've built and talk about how I can support your events, channels and campaigns.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

- Organisation: maintaining a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages, plus multi-site client content management alongside a remote team
- Writing & languages: fluent English, Dutch writing B1 and speaking A2+, Turkish native; writes SEO content, website copy and social/email material
- Digital tools & technical: daily LLM use for research, content and audits, prompt engineering, MCP integrations into WordPress, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, and an Android app live on Google Play
